x: Other successes during the month were by two of our junior members Hayman was second in the 100yds, and fourth in the 220yds.
Hayman, who has been seriously ill and undergone many operations, is now a little easier and, whilst he is not entirely out of danger, his gradual recovery may be confidently expected.

It was originally decided that 10 juniors should represent the Bels., so as not to call upon juniors to race twice, but owing to the absence of Hayman and Ford, through illness, Scrimshaw and Tosh were called upon to compete in two events.
Hayman, 1st, Long Jump, Oxted and District.
